passages.title: My ski trip
lines: From: Riko
To: Haru
Subject: My ski trip
Hi Haru,
I'm writing to you from my uncle's house in Nagano. My family arrived here on Saturday morning.
On the first day, I tried skiing for the first time. I fell down so many times that my legs hurt!
My cousin Taro is a great skier, so he taught me how to stop and turn.
By the second day, I could ski down the small hill without falling.
Yesterday it snowed a lot, so we stayed inside and made hot chocolate.
Tomorrow we're going to visit a snow monkey park, and then we'll go home on Wednesday.
I'll show you my photos at school next week.
See you soon, Riko

passages.title: Leo and the Old Bench
lines: Leo's grandfather lives in a small town by the sea.
Every summer, Leo stays with him for two weeks.
This year, his grandfather asked him for help. "The old bench in the park is broken," he said. "Let's fix it together."
Leo had never used a hammer before, so he was a little worried.
His grandfather showed him how to use the tools carefully.
They worked on the bench for three mornings.
On the fourth day, they painted it bright blue.
While they were painting, an old woman stopped to watch them.
"I sat on that bench with my husband many years ago," she said with a smile.
"Thank you for making it beautiful again."
Leo felt very proud.
Before he went home, he took a picture of the bench to show his friends.
Now he wants to learn how to make a bookshelf for his room.

writing.promptEn: Read the email from your friend Emma. Write a reply with about five sentences. Answer her two questions.

email: How are you? I just joined the cooking club at my school.
Last week, we made pancakes, and they were delicious.
Next month, we are going to cook food from different countries.
What kind of food do you like to cook or eat?
And what club or activity do you want to try this year?
writing.sample: Hi Emma, Thanks for your email. I like curry and rice, and I sometimes cook it with my dad. This year, I want to try the science club because I love experiments. Cooking food from different countries sounds fun. Please tell me about it next time!
